'''Wil al'Caar''' is a boy from [[Emond's Field]] in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wil al'Caar}}  He is the son of [[Nela al'Caar|Nela]] and [[Paet al'Caar]].

== Activities ==
He is injured during the first Trolloc attack on [[Emond's Field]] and is [[Healed]] by [[Moiraine Damodred]].
